rca_of_issue: Root cause: asyncpg returns JSONB columns (attendees) as raw JSON strings instead of Python lists when the RLS role is active (database.with_org() context uses a restricted PostgreSQL role that causes asyncpg to return JSONB as text). Code was iterating over the string characters and calling .get() on each char, raising 'str object has no attribute get'. This is the 3rd occurrence of this pattern in the project (previous: audit trail, team insights). Fix: _jlist() helper wraps all 6 attendees reads — passes lists through, JSON-parses strings, returns [] for None/invalid. Mitigation verified: processing.py now consistently uses _jlist() for all attendees access regardless of whether the connection is with_admin() or with_org().
